# Historical repair snapshots

Exact before/fixed source and upstream tests for four public historical fixes;
immutable commit URLs, blob identities, and SHA256 values are in PROVENANCE.json.
Licenses are retained. No bug is injected into these source snapshots.

The qualification selects unchanged upstream test function/class bodies and adds
separate consumer modules and explicitly authored audit/counterexamples. This is
not the complete upstream repository or an official benchmark. Historical source
and upstream tests may share model-assisted authorship; no independent cognition
provenance/capability credit is claimed. The expert fixed source is teaching-only;
held-out execution does not receive the fixed held-out source.
